findings.text: The merge releases a held tree by calling _release_run_workspace(release_record, integration_repo=..., integration_commit=...) without the retention argument that promotion passes from record['worktree_retention'] (reckon/crew/promotion_release.py:381), so a tree whose ledger row records worktree-retention ('retained as the working directory of recoverable session') is released rather than withheld when a merged head is later landed.

item_verdicts.call_sites: reckon/crew_run_commands.py:329 calls merge.land_merge for crew merge --head with release defaulting True and emits the whole report; reckon/crew/merge.py:846 (land) passes release=False so crew complete --land reports its own post-merge release exactly once.
item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against 1b3663ce4f: dbafecdb06 adds release_landed_worktrees and its call, d89d95d340 is a no-behaviour import/format sort, 66a2823528 adds only the 60-line evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when names three cases in tests/test_a_merge_releases_its_worktree.py; all three exist there and the base arm log records 2 failed / 1 passed while the head arm records 3 passed, EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: The node's goal is that crew merge releases the worktree its landed head leaves behind; reckon/crew/merge.py:800 calls release_landed_worktrees(repo, landed, head=head_sha) after the confirmed push and reports release.released/release.withheld.
item_verdicts.manifest: The manifest states status complete, records the gate command and both arm logs with their EXIT lines, names the negative control log and its 2-failure red result, and records the three commits.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The plan declares reckon/crew/merge.py and tests/test_a_merge_releases_its_worktree.py; the diff changes exactly those two plus the landing evidence fragment, which the dispatch's own orientation_write_paths declares. No file outside the declared scope was touched.

justifications.durability: The base arm's KeyError on report['release'] at tests/test_a_merge_releases_its_worktree.py:167 and the withheld-case failure show the added assertions redden when the release is absent, and the negative control removes the release to the same 2 failures.
justifications.evidence: The three-case gate exists and both arms are on disk: base-arm.log ends '2 failed, 1 passed' EXIT=1 and head-arm.log ends '3 passed' EXIT=0.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/merge.py:804-816 follows the module's docstring-plus-local-import idiom and reuses _rev_parse and _is_ancestor rather than shelling out again.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/merge.py:800-801 releases after the push is confirmed and the result names each tree, matching the plan's deliverable.
justifications.reuse: The new code reads the existing join obligations._held_worktree_records and the existing release path promotion_release._release_run_workspace, adding only the merge-commit predicate and the result summary; no existing owner performs a release keyed on the landed commit.
justifications.scope_discipline: The only third file in the diff, docs/evidence/fragments/a-promotion-reads-the-evidence-it-is-given/release-the-merged-worktree.html, is the landing record and is inside the dispatch's declared orientation write paths.
